_about: Curated, offline CVE catalogue for packages on this fleet. Sovereign: no external feed is queried at runtime. Each entry was reviewed against its references on the date given; add entries the same way (package, upstream affected range, references).

entries.name: regreSSHion
entries.summary: Signal-handler race condition in sshd allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux.

entries.name: ssh-agent PKCS#11 remote code execution
entries.summary: A forwarded ssh-agent can be made to load arbitrary shared libraries, enabling code execution on the agent's host.

entries.name: Baron Samedit
entries.summary: Heap-based buffer overflow in sudo's command-line parsing gives any local user root.

entries.name: sudo chroot local privilege escalation
entries.summary: sudo's -R (--chroot) option loads an attacker-controlled nsswitch.conf, giving a local user root.

entries.name: xz/liblzma backdoor
entries.summary: Malicious code in the xz 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 release tarballs backdoors liblzma, which sshd can load via libsystemd.
